findings.message: path template "/pets/{petId}" references "{petId}" but neither the operation nor its path item declares a path parameter named "petId"
"^(a+)+$" is ambiguous. An input of the form `aaaa` matches more than one way. A crafted value here may cost superlinear time to match.

path-param-undeclared.title: a path template placeholder with no parameter declaring it

ambiguous-pattern.title: a pattern whose matching can blow up on crafted input
ambiguous-pattern.explanation: A backtracking engine can be made to explore every way an ambiguous pattern matches, so an input crafted against it can take superlinear time. Whether a given pattern actually costs that depends on the engine running it, which is not known here. Rewrite the pattern to remove the ambiguity, or compile patterns with a linear-time engine through the regexCompiler option.
